sections.title: Listening
sections.instruction: 재생 버튼을 누르면 1번부터 순서대로 나와요. 한 번만 들려주니 잘 듣고 답하세요.

Dear Advice Column,
My best friend and I have known each other for five years. Recently, however, she has started spending most of her time with a new group of friends. She rarely talks to me during lunch and sometimes ignores my messages. I don't want to lose our friendship, but I'm afraid that talking to her about my feelings might make things worse. What should I do?

groups.passage: In the future, people may not need to visit supermarkets as often as they do today. Smart refrigerators will be able to check which foods are running out and automatically order them online. Some meals may even be prepared by robots. Although these technologies could save time, some people worry that they might reduce opportunities for families to cook and eat together.

questions.q: What is the word for "to become better at something"? (글에서 찾아 쓰세요)

groups.passage: David has always enjoyed playing sports. Although he isn't very good at basketball, he practices every afternoon because he wants to improve. On weekends, he plays tennis with his mother. Swimming, however, is his favorite sport because he feels comfortable in the water. His friends often invite him to play soccer after school, and he rarely refuses. ______________________.

questions.q: Which is not true about the story?

choices.①: Perfumers create different kinds of fragrances.
choices.②: A good sense of smell is important for perfumers.
choices.③: Perfumers need both creativity and scientific knowledge.
choices.④: All modern perfumes are made only from natural ingredients.
choices.⑤: Creating a new fragrance can take a long time.

groups.passage: A perfumer is someone who creates different kinds of fragrances. To become a successful perfumer, a person needs an excellent sense of smell, creativity, and scientific knowledge. Perfumers must recognize hundreds of different smells and understand how they change when mixed together. Although natural ingredients are often used, many modern perfumes also contain materials created in laboratories. Developing a new fragrance can take several months or even years.

questions.q: What is the next story about?

choices.②: The development of computers and their future possibilities
choices.③: The reasons people stopped using computers
choices.④: The differences between smartphones and televisions
choices.⑤: The importance of electricity in modern homes

groups.passage: The first electronic computers were enormous machines that filled entire rooms. One famous example was ENIAC, which was developed in the United States in the 1940s. Although it could solve complicated mathematical problems much faster than humans, it required a great deal of electricity and space. Since then, computers have become smaller, faster, and more powerful. Today, even a smartphone can perform tasks that early computer engineers could hardly have imagined.

questions.q: 다음 글을 통해 알 수 있는 필자에 관한 사실은?

groups.passage:
Dear Max,
It's been almost a month since you passed away, but I still expect to see you waiting by the front door whenever I come home. Yesterday, I found your favorite toy under the sofa. It reminded me of all the afternoons we spent playing in the backyard. I planted a small tree near your grave so that I can remember you every time I look outside.
I miss you so much.
Love,
Jason

questions.q: 다음 글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?

choices.②: What Do Students Learn at Clown School?

groups.passage: Most people attend school to study subjects such as math, science, and history. However, some schools offer very unusual classes. At clown schools, students learn how to perform funny tricks, wear colorful costumes, and make audiences laugh. They also practice physical movements and facial expressions. Although being a clown may seem easy, it requires creativity, patience, and many hours of practice.

questions.q: 다음 이야기의 줄거리와 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?

choices.①: 필자는 7학년 역사 수업에서 작가의 꿈을 갖게 되었다.
choices.②: 역사적 인물을 바탕으로 글을 쓰는 과제가 있었다.
choices.③: 필자는 탐험가와 함께 여행하는 상황을 상상했다.
choices.④: 필자는 좋은 성적을 받은 것이 가장 기뻤다.
choices.⑤: 필자는 자신의 상상력으로 이야기를 만들어 냈다.

groups.passage: I still remember the moment I first realized that I wanted to become a writer. It happened during a history class when I was in seventh grade. Our teacher asked us to write a story based on a historical figure. Instead of simply describing the person's life, I imagined myself traveling with the explorer Jacques Cartier. I spent several days writing and rewriting my story. When I received an A, I was pleased, but what excited me most was not the grade. It was the realization that I had created something entirely from my own imagination.

groups.passage:
How to Make Your Own Yoyo

◈ What you need :
· Two plastic bottle caps
· One small screw
· A piece of string
· Colored paper
· Scissors and glue

◈ Instructions
1. Make a small hole in the center of each bottle cap.
2. Push the screw through the first cap.
3. Tie one end of the string around the middle of the screw.
4. Connect the second cap, leaving a small space between the two caps.
5. Cut the colored paper into two circles and glue one circle onto the outside of each cap.

questions.q:
윗글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳을 고르시오.

You don't always have to travel far to discover something new.
윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

choices.③: How to Become a Famous Explorer
choices.⑤: Why People Prefer Living in Cities

groups.passage: Many people believe that traveling to another country is the best way to have an adventure. ( ① ) However, exciting discoveries can also be made close to home. ( ② ) For example, you might visit a local museum that you have never explored or learn about the history of an old building in your neighborhood. ( ③ ) You could also interview longtime residents to discover how your town has changed over the years. ( ④ ) These experiences may help you see familiar places from a completely different perspective. ( ⑤ ) Sometimes, the greatest adventures begin in the places we know best.

groups.passage:
One afternoon, a hungry crow found a piece of bread near a village.

(A) A fox passing by noticed the bread in the crow's beak. Wanting it for himself, the fox began praising the crow's beautiful feathers and wonderful voice.

(B) The crow picked up the bread and flew to a tall tree. He sat on a branch, planning to enjoy his meal without being disturbed.

(C) Flattered by the fox's words, the crow opened his mouth to sing. At that moment, the bread fell to the ground, and the fox quickly grabbed it and ran away.
